acceptance_profile.training_scope: Represent training/command/task/trick/behavior semantics without assuming every companion is trainable or every behavior is teachable.
acceptance_profile.agency: Training cannot convert sapient autonomy into ownership or automatic obedience; source-confirmed sapient participation remains voluntary and consent-governed.
acceptance_profile.behavior_authority: Creature/species behavior remains source/profile/owner governed; CCP-04 may reference or propose learned behavior but cannot fabricate universal psychology or biology.
acceptance_profile.resolution: No universal training difficulty, duration, reliability, success chance or obedience formula; resolution must remain source/profile/GM or appropriate rules-owner scoped.
acceptance_profile.relationship_boundary: MIB-09 retains relationship identity/numeric state; training may reference relationship context but cannot mutate a duplicate bond ledger.
acceptance_profile.later_tranches: CCP-05 retains care/welfare; CCP-06 work/travel; CCP-07 combat/familiar mechanics; CCP-08 breeding; CCP-09 facilities; CCP-10 ecology; CCP-11 packaging/final proof.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused CCP-04 verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.
